args.finding: kubsdb root filesystem is at 97% (1.7T of 1.8T, 51G left) and Postgres — the shared database for klams, korg and kfdc — has already PANIC'd twice on "No space left on device" writing pg_wal (02:52 and 02:58 UTC, i.e., in the last ~14 minutes). The 02:52 event forced a full restart (server processes aborted, "terminating any other active server processes", recovered at 02:52:14); the 02:58 panic has no recovery line after it, so the second incident's outcome is unclear. Postgres is currently up and listening on 5432 and all dependent services (korg 8720, klams 8710, kfdc 8740, prometheus, grafana, registry, nginx) show listening, but the disk will fill again fast and the next WAL write failure can corrupt/lose committed data. Cause identified: docker images hold 1.19TB, of which 1.15TB (96%) is reclaimable — the bulk is 12 nightly tags of ghcr.io/kenhia/hv-simulator at 38.1GB each (~457GB) plus other untagged/dangling images; local volumes add another 61GB reclaimable. Memory (44G available) and swap are fine; no failed systemd units.
